name: Build APK
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Cek isi repositori
        run: |
          echo "== Isi repositori =="; ls -la
          echo "== Isi folder www =="
          ls -la www || { echo "GAGAL: folder www tidak ada. Upload ulang isi zip (folder www harus ada di halaman utama repositori)."; exit 1; }
          test -f www/index.html || { echo "GAGAL: www/index.html tidak ada."; exit 1; }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 22 }
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with: { distribution: temurin, java-version: 21 }
      - name: Kunci tanda tangan tetap (agar APK baru bisa menimpa aplikasi lama)
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.android
          echo "" | base64 -d > ~/.android/debug.keystore
      - name: Tulis konfigurasi aplikasi (nama Workout)
        run: |
          cat > capacitor.config.json <<'EOF'
          {
            "appId": "id.nutrisense.app",
            "appName": "NutriSense",
            "webDir": "www",
            "plugins": { "LocalNotifications": { "smallIcon": "ic_stat_latihan", "iconColor": "#2B50E6" } }
          }
          EOF
      - name: Pasang Capacitor
        run: |
          [ -f package.json ] || npm init -y
          npm install @capacitor/core@7 @capacitor/cli@7 @capacitor/android@7
      - name: Buat proyek Android
        run: npx cap add android
      - name: Ikon, izin, dan suara alarm
        run: |
          cat > /tmp/patch.mjs <<'EOF'
          import fs from 'fs';
          const res = 'android/app/src/main/res', man = 'android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml';
          let x = fs.readFileSync(man, 'utf8');
          for (const p of ['POST_NOTIFICATIONS', 'VIBRATE', 'WAKE_LOCK', 'USE_EXACT_ALARM', 'SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM']) {
            if (!x.includes('android.permission.' + p + '"')) x = x.replace('<application', '<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.' + p + '" />\n    <application');
          }
          fs.writeFileSync(man, x); console.log('OK izin');
          const icon = fs.readFileSync('www/icon-192.png');
          for (const d of ['mdpi', 'hdpi', 'xhdpi', 'xxhdpi', 'xxxhdpi']) {
            fs.mkdirSync(res + '/mipmap-' + d, { recursive: true });
            for (const n of ['ic_launcher.png', 'ic_launcher_round.png']) fs.writeFileSync(res + '/mipmap-' + d + '/' + n, icon);
          }
          fs.rmSync(res + '/mipmap-anydpi-v26', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('OK ikon');
          fs.mkdirSync(res + '/drawable', { recursive: true });
          fs.writeFileSync(res + '/drawable/ic_stat_latihan.xml', '<vector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:width="24dp" android:height="24dp" android:viewportWidth="24" android:viewportHeight="24"><path android:fillColor="#FFFFFFFF" android:pathData="M7,11h10v2H7zM4,8h2v8H4zM18,8h2v8h-2zM2,10h2v4H2zM20,10h2v4h-2z"/></vector>');
          const sr = 22050, n = sr * 8, b = Buffer.alloc(44 + n * 2);
          b.write('RIFF', 0); b.writeUInt32LE(36 + n * 2, 4); b.write('WAVEfmt ', 8); b.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); b.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); b.writeUInt16LE(1, 22);
          b.writeUInt32LE(sr, 24); b.writeUInt32LE(sr * 2, 28); b.writeUInt16LE(2, 32); b.writeUInt16LE(16, 34); b.write('data', 36); b.writeUInt32LE(n * 2, 40);
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const t = i / sr, ph = t % 1.2; let a = 0;
            for (const st of [0, 0.3, 0.6]) if (ph >= st && ph < st + 0.2) { const u = (ph - st) / 0.2; a = Math.min(u * 15, (1 - u) * 15, 1); }
            b.writeInt16LE(Math.round(32767 * 0.6 * a * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1000 * t)), 44 + i * 2);
          }
          fs.mkdirSync(res + '/raw', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(res + '/raw/rest_done.wav', b); console.log('OK suara');
          EOF
          node /tmp/patch.mjs
      - run: npx cap sync android
      - run: cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Workout-APK
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
